ideation.icp_description: Small-to-mid B2B companies that are actively hiring an SDR / BDR — a strong signal they're scaling outbound and likely understaffed for sender infrastructure, sequencing, and inbox management.
ideation.offer: Navreo runs cold email infrastructure DFY — sender setup, sequences, deliverability, and inbox management on a pay-per-lead model.
why_signal_fits_angles: Hiring an SDR is committing to outbound, but the new SDR will need senders + sequences + warmed inboxes from day one
Heads of Sales often inherit the infrastructure problem and welcome a partner who removes the setup overhead
Pay-per-lead model means the company pays only when we generate qualified leads — lower risk than another internal hire

angles_tested.drop_reason: Below 60% fit threshold — contact-centre/B2C enrolment/real-estate automation noise

angles_tested.kept_reason: Mostly overlaps A via substring matching — kept only 'First Sales Hire' and 'Founding Sales Hire' as unique adds

qualification._purpose: Role-only judgement layer applied by lilly-theirstack-data-processing Phase 2.5. Classifies each new Jobs row as QUALIFIED or OFF_BRIEF based on whether the role is a genuine IC-level SDR/BDR hire. Companies are NEVER excluded by this gate — only specific roles. Borderlines disabled per user preference (binary qualification only).
qualification.role_signal_definition: The new hire will be an IC-level outbound prospector building or expanding the company's SDR motion. A first-or-early SDR hire at a 10-200 emp B2B company is the canonical fit. Manager/Director-level SDR hires are a DIFFERENT signal (scaling existing team — out of scope for this brief).
qualified_role_patterns: SDR / BDR / ADR (Account Development Rep) IC-level
Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, Outbound SDR, Inbound SDR, Senior SDR, Senior BDR
Outbound Sales Representative, Lead Generation Representative (at B2B SaaS / tech-services, NOT contact centre / B2C / wholesale)
First SDR / Founding SDR / First BDR / Founding BDR / First Sales Hire / Founding Sales Hire (strongest signal — greenfield outbound)
disqualified_role_patterns: Internal recruiter / agency-side role with 'Sales Development' in title (staffing firms hiring SDRs for clients, not internally)
Manager / Director / Head of Sales Development / SDR Manager / SDR Team Lead — different signal (scaling existing team, not first-SDR-build)
'Business Development' at law firms / accountancy practices / consultancies / brokerages — means partnership/relationship development, not outbound prospecting
'Business Development Manager' at distributors / wholesalers / dealerships — account management for existing book of business
Sales Engineer / Solutions Engineer flavoured BDR roles — technical pre-sales, not prospecting
Inside Sales Representative without 'development' or 'outbound' qualifier — often transactional closer roles
Customer Development / Customer Success Rep — retention/expansion, not new-logo outbound
Field Sales Rep / Territory Sales Rep / Route Sales Rep — field-quota IC role, not outbound
Sponsorship SDR / Delegate Acquisition (event/media sales) — different motion (not pure cold-email infra fit)

personalization._note: Email copy is ground truth. Skill 2 reads the campaign email body → identifies all {{merge_variables}} → looks up generation instructions in per_lead_variables below. Cloned from GTM campaign 3331499 — same merge variable schema. Pricing language: 'pay-per-lead basis' (NOT 'pay-per-result' / 'performance basis' like GTM brief) — keep consistent across all generated copy.

Role.instructions: Direct field lookup WITH email-readability normalisation. Copy the Jobs row's 'Job Title' value, then normalise so it reads naturally after the hardcoded 'Saw you were hiring a ___' hook. Same rules as GTM brief: replace ', ' separating level word from function area with ' of ', drop bracketed/parenthetical text, preserve seniority words ('Senior', 'Director', 'Manager', 'Head', 'VP', 'Lead'). No LLM call needed for rule-based cases.
Role.validation: Non-empty. Must read naturally after 'Saw you were hiring a ___'. Must NOT contain commas in the level-word/function-area position. Must NOT contain parens.

Icebreaker.instructions: Delegate to lilly-icebreaker. CRITICAL: SKIP both the Hiring angle AND the 'You joined' (change-of-roles) angle. The email's hook already explicitly references the hiring signal via {{Role}}; referencing the DM's own recent role change compounds the personal-detective signal in a way that reads stalkerish (rule set 2026-05-17 — applies to ALL hiring-signal briefs). Allowed angle waterfall: Colleague → Funding → Tech → Fallback. Pass DM's company + title + LinkedIn URL plus 'skip_angles: [Hiring, You joined]'.
Icebreaker.validation: Non-empty. Must NOT reference 'hiring', 'open role', 'looking for', or any active-hiring language. Must NOT reference the DM's recent role change ('stepped into', 'took over', 'new in your seat', 'X years in role').

HowWeCanHelp._note: Three angles in priority order. First matching trigger fires. Fallback (priority 99) always fires last. All three fit the email's 'wanted to reach out because ___' mid-sentence stem. Pricing language is 'pay-per-lead basis' throughout — NOT 'performance basis' / 'pay-per-result' (those belong to the GTM brief).

angles.instructions: When the company is making a founding or first-of-its-kind SDR hire, the new person walks into a build-from-scratch problem. Position Navreo as the outbound system layer so the SDR's first 90 days aren't burned on prospecting infrastructure. Anchor to: build the outbound system, free the SDR for conversations.
angles.example: we'd build the outbound system so the new SDR doesn't waste time on prospecting and can focus on conversations

angles.instructions: When the company already runs an SDR motion (multiple hires open OR mature outbound tech stack), position Navreo as a side-by-side capacity-add — not replacement. Anchor to: working alongside in-house SDRs on pay-per-lead.
angles.example: we work alongside in-house SDRs on a pay-per-lead basis to drive even more pipeline

angles.trigger: always — fires when no priority 1-2 angle matches
angles.instructions: Default fallback. Soft positioning: 'I thought you may be open to an outside team driving additional opportunities alongside the new hire on a pay-per-lead basis.' This must always fire so {{HowWeCanHelp}} is never empty. Pricing anchor 'pay-per-lead basis' is non-negotiable.
angles.example: I thought you may be open to an outside team driving additional opportunities alongside the new hire on a pay-per-lead basis

HowWeCanHelp.validation: 10-25 words. Starts mid-sentence (lowercase, since 'because' precedes it — EXCEPT fallback which starts with capitalised 'I' as it's the first-person pronoun). Pricing anchor 'pay-per-lead' present in priorities 2 and 99. Must NOT duplicate {{Cold Email Video Angle}}'s content.

Cold Email Video Angle.instructions:
Generate a one-line sentence-completion for the email stem 'I recorded a short-video for {{company_name}} showing a teaser of what we'd do to ___'. Pure ICP-connection angle: how we'd help the company reach their target buyers. Form: starts with an infinitive verb (drive / fill / open / build), references a sales outcome anchored to the company's specific ICP segment.

EXPLICITLY DO NOT INCLUDE: pricing model language (covered in {{HowWeCanHelp}}); channel/method ('through outbound'); the prospect's title; the company name (already in template adjacent to slot).

OVERRIDE NOTE: This instruction OVERRIDES Navreo's global memory rule 'feedback_cold_email_angle_title_relevance' (which says angle must reference title) FOR THIS BRIEF ONLY — the hook already references the role via {{Role}}.
Cold Email Video Angle.validation: 5-12 words, sentence-completion form (starts with infinitive, NOT a full sentence). References company's specific ICP segment. Must NOT repeat company name, prospect's title, pricing language, or channel/method.

CaseStudy.instructions: Delegate to lilly-personalisation's bucketed CaseStudy generation. Match a case study to the DM's role/vertical/company-size bucket (Navreo's standard bucket scheme). Inherits Navreo's default mapping.
CaseStudy.validation: Per lilly-personalisation's CaseStudy validation. Must include hard numbers.
